McKinsey Partner Demoted Over 'Glass Cliff' Comment

McKinsey partner Chris Bradley was demoted from his role at McKinsey Global Institute (MGI) after reportedly mentioning the 'glass cliff' phenomenon. The demotion has sparked debate, with some characterizing the decision as 'cowardice' and others defending it as speaking 'truth'. The 'glass cliff' refers to the phenomenon where women are more likely to be appointed to leadership positions during times of crisis or decline.
